name: FCM priority and deprioritization
plain: High priority pushes wake a sleeping phone, but Android downgrades apps that abuse them.
meaning: High priority is the only way to reach a dozing phone fast. Apps that send high priority with no visible notification get demoted over a 7 day window, so engagement bots must show something.

android.persistence: Deprioritization is evaluated over the previous 7 days per app instance; visible notifications prevent it
android.store_policy: FCM docs: use high priority only for time-sensitive, user-visible messages
android.note: Normal: delivered immediately if awake, deferred in Doze. High: can wake Doze, allowed limited work; standby bucket no longer sets the quota (Android 13). v2 RemoteNotification gets a 20 s execution window

limits.headline: Can wake a sleeping Android phone with a high priority push, but misuse gets slowed down
limits.user_action: Nothing. The app's server picks the priority when it sends a message
can: Wake a phone in Doze for something urgent like a call or chat
Do some short work right after the wake up
Send normal priority pushes that arrive quietly when the phone is awake
cannot: Use high priority for ads without getting downgraded
Deliver normal priority pushes right away while the phone is in Doze; they wait
Do long work after a wake up
Use this on iPhone, which has its own priority levels
limits.differs: Android has normal and high FCM priority. iPhone uses APNs priority 10, 5 and 1.

story.what_it_is: Whether a push can wake a sleeping Android phone right away, with penalties for abuse.

marketing.name: Message priority
marketing.pitch: Google explains high and normal priority in FCM and warns that misuse can cause lower priority delivery.

story.for_you: You get a call or chat alert even when the phone is dozing. Less urgent alerts wait until the phone wakes, so you may see them late.
story.for_makers: Makers need high priority to be on time for calls and chat. Android demotes apps that send high priority pushes without showing anything, so they must show a visible alert.

use_cases.example: A call app uses high priority so your phone rings when locked.
A glucose monitor sends a high priority low blood sugar alert.
A driver app gets an urgent ride request on a sleeping phone.
A game sends a normal priority daily reward alert that can wait.
A banking app sends a high priority fraud alert.
An ad team learns that silent high priority pushes get penalized, so campaigns must show a notice.
A doorbell app sends an instant visitor alert.

risks: Late alerts when priority is low
story.android_note: Android only. High priority pushes can be demoted over about a week if misused.
story.ios_note: iOS has a similar priority number in APNs.

technical_bounds: Proxying (Beta) can reduce delivery metrics up to 15%

abuse: High priority data wakeups to harvest signals

history.change: Doze introduced; high priority FCM is the main exemption
High priority count no longer tied to standby bucket; downgrade when no notification is shown
Legacy HTTP API shutdown begins; HTTP v1 message format with android config required
